title.zh: 生物剂与毒素（豁免）条例 2009
title.vi: Quy chế Tác nhân Sinh học và Độc tố (Miễn trừ) 2009
title.th: ข้อบังคับเชื้อก่อโรคและสารพิษ (การยกเว้น) 2009

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Biological Agents and Toxins (Exemption) Regulations 2009.

3.—(1) Every person who possesses or handles any exempted Fifth Schedule toxin in accordance with regulation 2(1) must —
(a)ensure that the exempted Fifth Schedule toxin is kept or stored in a facility which is safe and secure, and which is accessible only to persons authorised by the operator of the facility;
(b)report immediately to the Director, in such form and manner as the Director may require —
(i)all adverse incidents involving the exempted Fifth Schedule toxin; and
(ii)any loss, whether through theft or otherwise, of the exempted Fifth Schedule toxin;
(c)maintain an inventory of all the exempted Fifth Schedule toxins in the person’s possession, in such form as the Director may require, which must include records of the following:
(i)the place at which each exempted Fifth Schedule toxin is kept or used;
(ii)the use to which each exempted Fifth Schedule toxin is to be put and has been put;
(iii)the manner of disposal of each exempted Fifth Schedule toxin (where applicable);
(iv)the particulars of the transfer of each exempted Fifth Schedule toxin (where applicable), whether within the facility or between the facility and any other facility; and
(d)submit to the Director, in such form and manner as the Director may require —
(i)a report, before 30 June of the current year, on all the exempted Fifth Schedule toxins in the person’s possession between 1 December of the preceding year and 31 May of the current year (both dates inclusive); and
(ii)a report, before 31 December of the current year, on all the exempted Fifth Schedule toxins in the person’s possession between 1 June and 30 November of the current year (both dates inclusive).
(2) In every case in which a Fifth Schedule toxin is found to be present in any specimen analysed by a person under regulation 2(1), the person must immediately —
(a)destroy the specimen in the facility referred to in paragraph (1)(a); or
(b)if the person wishes to retain, transfer or transport the Fifth Schedule toxin, comply with the requirements of the Act relating to the possession, transfer or transportation of Fifth Schedule toxin, respectively.
(3) For the purposes of a report to be submitted to the Director before 31 December 2009 under paragraph (1)(d)(ii), the reference to 1 June in that paragraph is to be read as a reference to 1 November 2009.

4. Any person who contravenes any requirement specified in regulation 3(1) shall be guilty of an offence and shall be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $100,000 or to imprisonment for a term not exceeding 10 years or to both.
